name: Social Media Greeting
description: An energetic, scroll-stopping greeting tuned for short-form social — punchy, expressive, made to wave and welcome.

clips.prompt: {mascot_description} pops into frame with an excited expression and waves enthusiastically at the camera. Bright vibrant background, energetic upbeat motion, social-media ready.
The mascot does a playful little dance — a quick shimmy or sway side to side — with a huge smile. Lively, expressive body language, fun and engaging.
The mascot makes a fun reaction face — eyes wide with delight, then strikes a goofy thumbs-up pose. Quick, charming, snappy energy.
The mascot points directly at the camera as if calling out the viewer, then makes a heart-shape with hands or a high-five gesture. Warm, inviting, bursting with personality.
The mascot blows a playful kiss or gives a celebratory cheer with arms in the air. Confetti-like sparkles bloom around. Joyful, vibrant motion.
The mascot ends with a big wink and a final wave, then strikes a fun signature pose. Punchy upbeat outro, ready to loop.
